summary: Sky Harbour Group Corp filed an 8-K reporting a $20 million borrowing amendment to its existing Term Loan Facility. The second amendment permits a draw for construction at Miami-Opa Locka Executive Airport and requires a $20 million cash replenishment from Series 2026 bond proceeds. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine financing arrangement.
